lore.shield: Brace and the net force on you is zero, so nothing that hits you gets to decide where you stand.
lore.sword: Force is mass times acceleration: the blade brings the mass and you bring the acceleration.
lore.gun: It drives the shot forward and drives you backward by exactly as much, every single time.
lore.charging: Momentum does not negotiate; you cannot cut it or shoot it away, you can only refuse to be moved.
lore.stunned: It rebounded off a braced player and put itself on the floor, which is the only moment a blade matters.
lore.airborne: Out of reach is out of reach, and the only force that travels is the one you fire.
lore.giant_apple: It uses all three laws against you, so all three are the only way back.
